say:3:1410537001:1.text: Hmm, why is there so much water over there?
say:3:1410537001:1.source_cn: 这是翻涌的，无边的……好多水？

say:4:1410537002:1.text: Hey, don't get too close! That's the ocean, and please don't make us swim in to save you!
say:4:1410537002:1.source_cn: 喂！别靠那么近！那是大海，掉下去可不是闹着玩的！

say:5:1410537003:1.text: The ocean... So this is what it looks like... It's alive!
say:5:1410537003:1.source_cn: 大海……原来这就是大海……它在动！

say:6:1410537004:1.text: Whoa, look at those white foamy splashes! They're so high!
say:6:1410537004:1.source_cn: 哇！看那些白色的泡沫？溅得好高！

choice_prompt:7:1410537004.text: Whoa, look at those white foamy splashes! They're so high!
choice_prompt:7:1410537004.source_cn: 哇！看那些白色的泡沫？溅得好高！

say:8:1410537005:1.text: Ugh... it's salty! Hmm, the air is full of mist!
say:8:1410537005:1.source_cn: 唔……好咸的味道！空气里好像都是水气！
say:8:1410537005:1.male: Ugh... it's salty! Hmm, the air is full of mist!
say:8:1410537005:1.female: Ugh... it's salty! Hmm, the air is full of mist!

say:9:1410537006:1.text: This kid's way too excited... I'm almost feeling sorry for him. What did the Essail even teach him?!
say:9:1410537006:1.source_cn: 这小子也太兴奋了……那些艾塞勒都教了他什么啊？！
